objective: Implement complete read-only OFFLINE parsing and independent arithmetic reconciliation of exported Alpaca trading account snapshots, activity pages, order lists and separately declared expenses. Never infer broker authentication from local JSON, never call private Alpaca/Render APIs, never trade.

interface.source: offline customer/exported raw JSON; never ask for API keys, account IDs printed or token values
interface.account_identity: one account and currency USD, explicitly PAPER or LIVE, source claims always UNAUTHENTICATED
interface.interval: baseline to terminal UTC, explicit snapshot-time and collection time, no future receipt claims
input_components: orders rows and complete pagination flag
account activity pages: original FILL, FEE, CFEE, cash flow codes
cost report separately declared with coverage
quote and opportunity traces if available
output: external-cost coverage and activity authenticity gates

adversarial_tests: Partial fills matching order cumulative quantity, including canceled remainder
Duplicated activity ID and incomplete pages fail before certification
Fees not double-counted against NAV; absent FEE/CFEE coverage remains blocker
Cash/share mismatch and fee sign tampering rejected
Future timestamp, off-window activity and unjustified chronological financing rejected
Deposit/withdrawal rejected for simple compound without time-weighted return
Unauthenticated JSON evidence never labelled broker authenticated
No final M10 opened or new account/order executed
Order status new/accepted/rejected/filled/partially_filled must match cumulative exact fills

source_capture_amendment.persistent_source: private 0600 exclusive local files only; never GitHub
source_capture_amendment.pagination: activities page_token, orders refuse >=500 due undocumented cursor
